title: Album release: Ringo Starr And His All Starr Band Volume 2: Live From Montreux by Ringo Starr | 1993
content:
Ringo Starr And His All Starr Band Volume 2: Live From Montreux, the second live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 14 September 1993.

It was recorded at the Montreux Jazz Festival, held at the Montreux Convention Centre in Montreux, Switzerland, on 13 July 1992. It was the 30th show by the second All-Starr Band, whose tour of North America and Europe lasted for 62 dates between June and September 1992.

The album contains just 14 of the 26 songs performed during the show. They include his two singles from Time Takes Time – ‘Don’t Go Where the Road Don’t Go’ and ‘Weight Of The World’.

Live From Montreux was released by Rykodisc, and did not chart anywhere worldwide. The cover photography was by Katanzaro & Mahdessian and Henry Diltz.

Twelve of the album’s recordings later appeared on the 2001 box set The Anthology… So Far.
